caption: The original research workspace within its architectural setting, seen straight on.
source: Verified owner-designated original XR research CAD room and complete working setup, captured directly in native Rhino Rendered mode through the owner-selected Rhino MCP session. Only the selected high-resolution responsive raster derivatives are published.

render.kind: High-resolution transparent native Rendered front view of the original architectural research room

nativeEngine.name: Rhino 8 native Rendered interactive viewport via owner-selected Rhino MCP

render.cachedMeshCoverage: Independent source inspection inventories original authored/cached render meshes; every selected surface retains original geometry. Native Rhino renders the unchanged original scene directly.
render.units: Original source millimetres/Z-up retained for native capture.
render.materialPolicy: Original native source-assigned CAD materials, object/layer appearance, authored vertex colours and TV texture/UV assignments. Temporary native directional lighting improves depth and surface reading while preserving original geometry and materials.
render.bitmapPolicy: The original TV/screen material appearance is rendered in place; no generated replacement, redrawn picture, screen warp or standalone private bitmap is published.
render.tvGeometryPolicy: Exact source world-space screen vertices, quad topology, UVs and material assignment match independently read original values before and after capture. Natural perspective from the original TV orientation is retained.
render.cutaway: Restore the original architectural room, floor/carpet, ceiling, rear/side walls and fixtures. Remove only the obstructing front-facade glass/frame assembly and approved foremost speaker row/two cabinets from capture visibility. Original hidden objects and non-surface annotations remain excluded.

visibility.architecturePolicy: Retain the original side/rear walls, ceiling, floor/carpet, doors, acoustic/diffusion wall elements, fixtures and non-obstructing front threshold.
visibility.foregroundHiddenPolicy: Open the front-facing glass/window-frame assembly and hide the foremost speaker row/two cabinets that obstruct the central working view. Retain side, rear, overhead and internal equipment.

render.alphaPolicy: Each lossless exact WebP decodes to every original native PNG RGBA byte, including fully transparent RGB and antialiased edges. No background erasure, image warp, crop, resampling, recolouring or compositing.

camera.basis: Original source millimetres and Z-up; no coordinate conversion, reflection or object relocation.
camera.compositionPolicy: Straight, level front view of the original architectural room and complete working setup. Preserve its central axis and real source asymmetry. Record requested framing separately from actual native alpha support; display with uniform proportional containment.

environment.reason: The original room floor receives native illumination; the renderer-generated infinite ground plane remains disabled.

lighting.recipe: Neutral source-compatible key, subtle cool fill and warm rim in original native coordinates.
